en.title: Matrix Traversal
en.description: Start from any cell in the first row of a 4×4 matrix; at each step, move to the next row in an adjacent column. Maximize the initial 100 energy minus the total of the values of the cells visited.
en.output: Output the maximum energy that can remain after reaching the last row; it may be negative.
en.explanation: A linear scan/dynamic programming solution follows directly from the rules; the examples have been checked one by one against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a concrete array/state transition, then analyze the boundaries.
